question: Seema wins gold in women’s discus at Indian Open Throws Competition 2025. Where was the Indian Open Throws Competition 2025 held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Navi Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Seema wins gold in women’s discus at Indian Open Throws Competition 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Seema** won the **gold medal** in the women’s **discus throw** event at the **Indian Open Throws Competition 2025** in **Navi Mumbai** with a throw of **56.39 metres**.
 
• **Neetika Verma** secured the **silver medal** with a throw of **50.23 metres**, and **Priya** won the **bronze** with a throw of **48.88 metres**.
 
• The opening day also featured **qualifying rounds** for the men’s **javelin** and **discus throw** events.
